items.q: 1. Do you remove all types of stoves, including gas and electric?
a: Yes! We remove all stove types – gas, electric, induction, and residential ranges. Our team handles every model safely and professionally, regardless of fuel type or size.

items.q: 2. Will you disconnect my stove before removal?
a: Absolutely. Our licensed technicians properly disconnect gas/electric lines and safely cap gas connections. You don’t need to do anything – we handle all disconnections professionally.

items.q: 3. How much does stove removal cost?
a: Our pricing depends on the stove type, location, and any required disconnections. We provide free, no-obligation quotes to give you accurate pricing for your specific situation. Contact us for details.

items.q: 4. What areas do you serve for stove removal?
a: We serve all of Toronto and the Greater Toronto Area, including North York, Scarborough, Mississauga, and Vaughan. Call to confirm service in your exact neighborhood.
